phase_0.boundary_condition: The global Frobenius closure where every trajectory starting above one descends and the halving/tripling split reconstitutes the identity, preventing escape or non-trivial cycles.

⊢.justification: The void state before the integer is instantiated or the map is applied.

⊣.justification: The terminal anchor containing the system; the 1-4-2 loop is the closed boundary that all orbits must reach.

≻.justification: The forward morphism on the odd branch, increasing magnitude before the subsequent division.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism on the even branch, decreasing magnitude and driving the descent.

⋈.justification: The sequential chaining of map applications that forms the trajectory.

⊙.justification: The identity of the orbit recognizing itself as a closed loop or a path returning to the identity.

∈.justification: The co-multiplication that splits the integer state into two distinct arms based on even or odd parity.

∋.justification: The multiplication that fuses the halving and tripling arms back into a single state, enforcing the identity constraint.

⊤.justification: The constructive truth of the even branch, affirming the halving operation.

⊥.justification: The constructive falsity of the odd branch relative to the descent, marking the tripling operation as the 'negative' or 'resistance' arm.

⊞.justification: The paradice state where the orbit holds both the potential for ascent (tripling) and descent (halving) simultaneously at the critical point.

◻.justification: The permanent, append-only record of the integer sequence generated by the map.

phase_3.void_description: The state before an integer is chosen or the map is initialized.
phase_3.true_description: The state where the orbit has successfully descended below its starting value.
phase_3.false_description: The state where the orbit fails to descend (hypothetical divergence or non-trivial cycle), which is non-instantiable in this domain.
phase_3.both_description: The state where the orbit is at the critical threshold, holding the tension between ascent and descent simultaneously.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with an arbitrary positive integer n greater than 1.
Split the integer state into two branches based on parity (even or odd).
Anchor the even branch with the affirmative evaluation of the halving operation.
Execute the halving morphism (n/2) on the even branch, driving the value downward.
Anchor the odd branch with the negative evaluation of the tripling operation.
Execute the forward morphism (3n+1) on the odd branch, increasing the value.
Execute the secondary halving morphism ((3n+1)/2) on the odd branch to complete the shortcut step.
Fuse the even and odd branches back into a single state, enforcing the identity constraint mu-circ-delta equals id.
Compose the fused state with the next iteration of the map.
Hold the critical state where the orbit balances between ascent and descent at the threshold.
Record the current integer value in the permanent trajectory log.
Recognize the orbit as a self-referential structure that must eventually return to the identity.
Re-split the new state for the next iteration if it is still above the unit cycle.
Re-evaluate the even branch for the next step.
Re-apply the halving morphism on the new even branch.
Re-evaluate the odd branch for the next step.
Re-apply the tripling morphism on the new odd branch.
Re-apply the secondary halving morphism on the new odd branch.
Re-fuse the branches to maintain the identity constraint.
Chain the result to the next iteration.
Append the new value to the trajectory record.
Terminate the process when the orbit reaches the unit cycle 1-4-2, the closed boundary.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The parity-gated map that translates integer states into halving or tripling operations.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The iterative composition of map steps that communicates state changes between iterations.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The append-only trajectory record that stores the sequence of integers visited.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The deterministic parity check that determines the order of operations (halving vs tripling).
phase_5.alfs_store: The descent crystal 3442270, the canonical reference point where the Frobenius closure is verified.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The computational work of evaluating parity and performing arithmetic operations.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: An integer state n with potential energy (magnitude) above the unit cycle.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A descended integer state m < n, closer to the unit cycle.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is entropy-conservative because the Frobenius reconnection (mu-circ-delta equals id) ensures that the information lost in the split is recovered in the fuse, maintaining the structural integrity of the orbit.

⊞=𐑳: The Collatz map's fundamental operation involves an asymmetric split between halving (division by 2) and tripling (multiplication by 3), creating unequal counts on each branch of the trajectory.
◻=𐑭: The merging of halving and tripling branches to compose the identity implies a non-trivial integer winding number that prevents continuous deformation to a trivial state.
⊙=⊙: The description of trajectories merging to compose the identity and forcing every path down indicates a self-organizing balance at the threshold between divergence and convergence, characteristic of criticality.

⋈=𐑐: The geometric reconnection of halving and tripling branches enforces a deterministic descent, ensuring near-certain firing with high information fidelity.
⊤=𐑧: The description of orbits being forced downward and unable to escape below their starting value indicates a kinetically frozen state where rearrangement requires external driving.
∈=𐑔: The description of orbits descending from any start and merging globally implies a scale-free propagation where local interactions influence the entire system's trajectory.
∋=𐑝: The requirement that halving and tripling branches must merge back to compose the identity implies that all necessary components must be present simultaneously for the reconnection to occur.
